semiconductor_relevance: Medium — New J.R. Electronic specializes in power and energy solutions that are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: New J.R. Electronic Co., Ltd. offers comprehensive power and energy-saving solutions, focusing on digitally programmable AC/DC power supplies and power modules. Their products cater to various applications including communications, industrial, computing, data storage, and healthcare, making them relevant for semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Established in Taiwan in 1997, the company has a strong local presence and expertise.
